title: 相干光纖骨幹傳輸
summary: 以相干接收、DSP 補償與光通道品質串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect coherent reception, dsp compensation and optical-channel quality through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 相干量測：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Coherent measurement: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「相干量測」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For coherent measurement, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「相干量測」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：本地振盪光提供相位參考，不只是強度量測。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留調變，只改 OSNR。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「I/Q 訊號」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around coherent measurement, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: A local optical oscillator supplies phase reference, beyond intensity detection. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat i/q signals as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留調變，只改 OSNR。 比較「相干量測」與「I/Q 訊號」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Compare whether evidence for coherent measurement and i/q signals supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 相干 DSP 可無限恢復任何低功率訊號。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Coherent DSP can recover arbitrarily weak signals without limit. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「相干量測」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for coherent measurement. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 本地振盪光提供相位參考，不只是強度量測。
knowledge.textEn: A local optical oscillator supplies phase reference, beyond intensity detection.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「I/Q 訊號」：正交分量共同表達複數光場資訊。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「相干量測」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring i/q signals: Quadrature components jointly represent complex field information. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove coherent measurement passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 保留調變，只改 OSNR。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假設 32 GBd、DP-QPSK 共 4 bit/符號，毛速率 128 Gbit/s；20% 以毛速率為分母的開銷後 payload 為 102.4 Gbit/s。忽略成形與實際 FEC。
knowledge.textEn: At assumed 32 GBd and DP-QPSK carrying four bits/symbol, gross rate=128 Gbit/s; overhead equal to 20% of gross leaves 102.4 Gbit/s, ignoring shaping and actual FEC.

quiz.question: 針對「相干量測」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of coherent measurement?
options: 本地振盪光提供相位參考，不只是強度量測。
相干 DSP 可無限恢復任何低功率訊號。
只檢查「I/Q 訊號」，便可取代「相干量測」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: A local optical oscillator supplies phase reference, beyond intensity detection.
Coherent DSP can recover arbitrarily weak signals without limit.
Checking i/q signals alone replaces verification specific to coherent measurement.
quiz.explanation: 本地振盪光提供相位參考，不只是強度量測。 相鄰的「I/Q 訊號」有不同責任：正交分量共同表達複數光場資訊。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: A local optical oscillator supplies phase reference, beyond intensity detection. Neighboring i/q signals has a different role: Quadrature components jointly represent complex field information. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 相干量測：對照試驗與證據

steps.objective: 針對「相干量測」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For coherent measurement, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: A local optical oscillator supplies phase reference, beyond intensity detection. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from i/q signals to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.

steps.observationEn: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Compare whether evidence for coherent measurement and i/q signals supports the same inference.

steps.failureEn: Coherent DSP can recover arbitrarily weak signals without limit. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「相干量測」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

knowledge.textEn: Two polarizations carry data but require mixing compensation.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「符號與位元」：baud 與 bit/s 由調變及偏振數連接。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「雙偏振」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring symbols and bits: Baud and bit/s connect through modulation and polarization count. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove dual polarization passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 保留調變，只改 OSNR。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「雙偏振」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of dual polarization?
options: 相干 DSP 可無限恢復任何低功率訊號。
只檢查「符號與位元」，便可取代「雙偏振」的專屬驗證。
兩個偏振可承載資料，但需補償相互混合。
optionsEn: Coherent DSP can recover arbitrarily weak signals without limit.
Checking symbols and bits alone replaces verification specific to dual polarization.
Two polarizations carry data but require mixing compensation.
quiz.explanation: 兩個偏振可承載資料，但需補償相互混合。 相鄰的「符號與位元」有不同責任：baud 與 bit/s 由調變及偏振數連接。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Two polarizations carry data but require mixing compensation. Neighboring symbols and bits has a different role: Baud and bit/s connect through modulation and polarization count. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 雙偏振：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Dual polarization: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「雙偏振」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For dual polarization, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「兩個偏振可承載資料，但需補償相互混合。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：保留調變，只改 OSNR。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「符號與位元」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Two polarizations carry data but require mixing compensation. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from symbols and bits to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 保留調變，只改 OSNR。 比較「雙偏振」與「符號與位元」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Compare whether evidence for dual polarization and symbols and bits supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 相干 DSP 可無限恢復任何低功率訊號。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Coherent DSP can recover arbitrarily weak signals without limit. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「雙偏振」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for dual polarization. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

steps.title: 符號與位元：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Symbols and bits: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「符號與位元」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For symbols and bits, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「符號與位元」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：baud 與 bit/s 由調變及偏振數連接。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留調變，只改 OSNR。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「OSNR」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around symbols and bits, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Baud and bit/s connect through modulation and polarization count. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat optical signal-to-noise ratio as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 保留調變，只改 OSNR。 比較「符號與位元」與「OSNR」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix modulation and vary OSNR. Compare whether evidence for symbols and bits and optical signal-to-noise ratio supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 提高調變階數一定提高每條實際光路容量。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Higher modulation order always raises actual path capacity. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「符號與位元」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for symbols and bits. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
